# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

If you find a security issue in **Immersion**, please report it privately.
Do **not** open a public GitHub issue for security problems.

**Report it here:** https://kvrnl.io/contact/

Include what you found, how to reproduce it, and the version you're on
(shown in the app's About screen). We'll acknowledge your report and keep you
posted on the fix.

## Supported versions

Only the **latest release** of Immersion receives security updates.
The app auto-updates, so staying current is automatic.

| Version | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| Latest release | ✅ |
| Anything older | ❌ |

## Scope

In scope: the Immersion desktop application and its licensing/update flow.

Out of scope: the KVRNL website and account system — report those the same way,
but note they're tracked separately.

## Please don't

- Don't run denial-of-service tests against KVRNL infrastructure.
- Don't access, modify, or destroy other people's data.
- Don't publish the issue before we've had a chance to fix it.

Thanks for helping keep KVRNL users safe.
